title: TEHRAN, November 4th - Effigies of Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu being set on fire in Enghelab Square during commemorations marking the anniversary of the 1979 US Embassy takeover by students and Iran’s Day of Fight Against Global Arrogance.
text: TEHRAN, November 4th - Effigies of Donald Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu being set on fire in Enghelab Square during commemorations marking the anniversary of the 1979 US Embassy takeover by students and Iran’s Day of Fight Against Global Arrogance.
